crossRefs.note: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor…
“If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
“Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;
to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their…
They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the…
They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and…
Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but…
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

translations.web: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
translations.bsb: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not wrest the justice due to thy poor in his cause.
